UI/UX Execution: Create wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity interactive prototypes in Figma, balancing visual aesthetics with functional usability.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, front-end engineers, and users to ensure technical feasibility, seamless design handoff, and quality implementation.

Pain Point Identification & Optimization: Uncover key pain points by synthesizing user feedback, requirement scoping, and A/B test insights to design scalable, systemic solutions; actively construct scenario-based contexts to help users visualize abstract workflows.

Cross-Platform Systems: Deep understanding of multi-platform design principles, responsive web architecture, and design system governance.

Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to simplify complex B2B information architecture into clear, intuitive visual structures.
Familiarity with micro-interactions, motion design, or interactive UI elements.

description.text:
We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented Web Designer with strong experience in B2B digital experiences and scalable design systems. In this role, you will take ownership of our digital web presence across multiple platforms. You will translate complex B2B business concepts and user flows into elegant, intuitive, and conversion-driven web experiences.
【Key Responsibilities】
1. B2B Web Experience: Design, refine, and optimize high-converting B2B websites, enterprise applications, and interactive web experiences tailored for enterprise audiences.
2. Cross-Platform System Design: Build, maintain, and scale responsive design systems and component libraries to ensure visual and functional consistency across web, tablet, and mobile platforms.
3. UI/UX Execution: Create wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity interactive prototypes in Figma, balancing visual aesthetics with functional usability.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, front-end engineers, and users to ensure technical feasibility, seamless design handoff, and quality implementation.
5. Pain Point Identification & Optimization: Uncover key pain points by synthesizing user feedback, requirement scoping, and A/B test insights to design scalable, systemic solutions; actively construct scenario-based contexts to help users visualize abstract workflows.
【Minimum Qualification】
1. Relevant Experience: 3+ years of professional web design experience, with a proven portfolio demonstrating strong expertise in B2B websites, SaaS products, or enterprise digital platforms.
2. Figma Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Figma (including Auto Layout, Component Sets, Design Tokens/Variables, and Interactive Prototyping).
3. Cross-Platform Systems: Deep understanding of multi-platform design principles, responsive web architecture, and design system governance.
4. Technical Awareness: Basic understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, modern layout frameworks) to communicate effectively with development teams.
5. Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to simplify complex B2B information architecture into clear, intuitive visual structures.
【Preferred Qualification】
1. Experience with enterprise applications.
2. Familiarity with micro-interactions, motion design, or interactive UI elements.
